hook.text: OpenAI launched always-on AI agents. Developers cloned them for free in about an hour. Here's OpenDots.
hook.tts: Open A.I. launched always-on A.I. agents. Developers cloned them for free, in about an hour. Here is Open Dots.

headline: OpenAI Dots:
agents that never sleep
stories.text: OpenAI's Dots are agents with their own cloud computer. They work on your goals around the clock and connect to over four thousand apps. They come with ChatGPT Pro and Business Premium.
stories.tts: Open A.I.'s Dots are agents with their own cloud computer. They work on your goals around the clock, and connect to over four thousand apps. They come with ChatGPT Pro, and Business Premium.

headline: OpenDots:
your own Dots
stories.text: Within about an hour, open-source clones hit Hacker News. OpenDots is one: an always-on agent you host yourself, MIT licensed and free to use.
stories.tts: Within about an hour, open source clones hit Hacker News. Open Dots is one: an always-on agent you host yourself, M.I.T. licensed, and free to use.

headline: Any model,
your server
stories.text: You pick the model, Claude, OpenAI, or cheaper open models through OpenRouter, and deploy it on Cloudflare, Render, Docker or Fly. You pay only for what you use.
stories.tts: You pick the model: Claude, Open A.I., or cheaper open models through Open Router. And deploy it on Cloudflare, Render, Docker, or Fly. You pay only for what you use.

headline: Early, but
worth watching
stories.text: These projects are days old, so expect rough edges, and set your own safety limits before an agent touches real accounts. But the idea of owning your agent is here.
